# University of Bridgeport

> A leading Connecticut university offering undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs in health sciences, psychology, and professional fields with a focus on career preparation and student support.

University of Bridgeport serves students near New York City and Boston with diverse program offerings including nursing, dental hygiene, chiropractic, and online learning options. The university emphasizes financial aid accessibility, transfer pathways, and alumni engagement through the Purple Knights community.

## Key Topics

- Admissions (undergraduate, graduate, online, transfer, international)
- Financial Aid & Scholarships
- College of Health Sciences
- Nursing & Dental Hygiene Programs
- Test-Optional Policy
- FAFSA & Student Financial Services

- Purple Knights
- Career Development
- Alumni Engagement
- Trustee & Presidential Scholarships
- Online Learning
- Transfer Students
- Connecticut Guarantee
- Student Services

## Admissions & Application

- [Apply for Admission](https://www.bridgeport.edu/apply): Application portal for undergraduate, graduate, and Physician Assistant programs.
- [Admissions](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions): Main admissions hub with nursing, dental, and chiropractic program information.
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions/undergraduate): Undergraduate admissions with test-optional policy and scholarship information.
- [Graduate Student Resources](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions/graduate): Graduate admissions and resources for master's and doctoral degree programs.
- [Online Admissions](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions/online): Online program admissions with application deadlines and financial aid information.
- [Transfer Student Admissions](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions/transfer): Transfer student admissions with CT Guarantee and community college pathways.
- [International Admissions](https://www.bridgeport.edu/admissions/international): International student admissions near New York City and Boston.

## Financial Aid & Scholarships

- [Cost and Financial Aid](https://www.bridgeport.edu/cost-financial-aid): Financial aid planning with personal Financial Aid Officers and FAFSA guidance.
- [Scholarships and Financial Aid](https://www.bridgeport.edu/cost-financial-aid/financial-aid/types-of-aid): Scholarship types including Trustee, merit-based, music, and STEM robotics aid.
- [Tuition and Fees](https://www.bridgeport.edu/cost-financial-aid/tuition-fees): Tuition and fee pricing for undergraduate and graduate programs.

## Academic Programs

- [Academic Programs](https://www.bridgeport.edu/academics/programs): Directory of undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs across all schools.

## Campus Engagement & Visits

- [Visit UB](https://www.bridgeport.edu/visit): Campus visit scheduling, virtual tours, and open house events for prospective students.
- [Request Information](https://www.bridgeport.edu/landingpages/learn-more-web): Information request form for career-oriented programs and scholarship opportunities.
- [Request Information (Learn More)](https://www.bridgeport.edu/learnmore): Information request for career-oriented programs and scholarship opportunities.
- [Parents](https://www.bridgeport.edu/parents): Parent resources for homecoming, student support, and academic advising.

## Alumni & Community

- [Alumni](https://www.bridgeport.edu/alumni): Alumni Association membership, awards, and distinguished alumni recognition programs.
- [Support UB](https://www.bridgeport.edu/support-ub): Fundraising and philanthropic giving programs through the Office of Advancement.
- [Resources for Employers](https://www.bridgeport.edu/heckman/career-development/employers-alumni): Center for Career Development services for employer recruitment and internship opportunities.

## Student Support & Health

- [COVID-19](https://www.bridgeport.edu/covid-19): COVID-19 information hub covering testing, contact tracing, and campus health guidelines.

## University Overview

- [A Leading University in Connecticut](https://www.bridgeport.edu): University of Bridgeport homepage with programs in Psychology, Medical Sciences, and Public Health.
